stories.title: Humyn Labs raises $47 million in Series A
stories.summary: Physical AI startup Humyn Labs has raised $47 million in a Series A round comprising equity and debt. The Bengaluru-based company plans to use the funds to build deployment infrastructure in Brazil, South Korea and India, while expanding its R&D presence in San Francisco, London and Seoul.

stories.title: Boba Bhai raises $18 million in Series B
stories.summary: Boba Bhai has raised $18 million in Series B funding to expand its 120-store network and launch new brands. US-based Left Lane Capital joined the round as a new investor, alongside existing backers including Titan Capital. The chain focuses on bubble tea and Korean street food.

stories.title: InPrime Finserv raises Rs 101 crore in Series B
stories.summary: InPrime Finserv has raised Rs 101 crore in a Series B round led by FMO. The NBFC plans to use the capital to diversify into micro-mortgage products and deepen its investments in AI-driven use cases, including agentic AI and co-pilots. Existing investors Z47 and Pravega Ventures participated.

stories.title: Disseqt AI raises $8 million in Pre-Series A
stories.summary: AI governance startup Disseqt AI has raised $8 million in a Pre-Series A round led by Gresham House Ventures. The company plans to use the funds to expand its global enterprise customer base and strengthen its technology. Former Indian cricket captain Rahul Dravid participated as an angel investor.

stories.title: Soket AI raises $4 million from Bajaj Finserv
stories.summary: Soket AI has raised $4 million from Bajaj Finserv and Pennant Technologies to build indigenous foundation models focused on mathematics, coding and reasoning. The startup aims to bring domain expertise to its research. Bajaj Finance and Pennant Technologies each contributed approximately $2 million to the round.

stories.title: Henfruit raises $15 million in Series A
stories.summary: Henfruit has raised $15 million in a Series A funding round. The investment was led by Lok Capital and DSG Consumer Partners. The company operates within the startup ecosystem, focusing on capital raising and development.

stories.title: Nexon Omniverse raises Rs 485 crore
stories.summary: Nexon Omniverse, parent company of retailer Style Union, has raised Rs 485 crore in a Series E round to accelerate national expansion. The company plans to grow its store network from 200 to 450 by March 2030, moving from its southern India base into western and northern regions.

stories.title: Soket AI secures $4 million for enterprise AI
stories.summary: Soket AI has secured $4 million from Bajaj Finserv and Pennant Technologies to advance its homegrown foundation models. The Bengaluru-based startup is working to address the challenge of using AI with sensitive customer data. Each investor contributed approximately $2 million to the round.

stories.title: Cyient Semiconductors receives $10 million investment
stories.summary: Cyient Semiconductors has secured a $10 million equity investment from GlobalFoundries. The company stated the deal carries a pre-money valuation of $490 million, bringing its post-money valuation to $510 million. The announcement did not provide the calculation used to determine the combined valuation of the financing rounds.

stories.title: Recove Ventures raises Rs 56 crore
stories.summary: Plastic recycling startup Recove Ventures has raised Rs 56.25 crore in a mix of equity and debt. The company plans to use the capital to expand its recycling infrastructure across Karnataka and Maharashtra. Investors include Sumeet Narang of Samara Capital and non-banking financing company Capri Global.

stories.title: Celosia Therapeutics receives $2 million grant
stories.summary: Macquarie University spinout Celosia Therapeutics has received a $2 million grant from the NSW Emerging Technology Commercialisation Fund. The company is developing a gene therapy for motor neurone disease. It was the only applicant to receive the maximum grant from a pool shared among six startups.

stories.title: JohnAIC raises $1.9 million in pre-seed funding
stories.summary: Sovereign AI infrastructure startup JohnAIC has raised $1.9 million in a pre-seed round led by Crane Venture Partners. The Bengaluru-based company aims to scale production to 100 AI servers per month, allowing organizations to deploy artificial intelligence while retaining control over their own data and computing resources.

stories.title: Boltz raises $110 million Series A
stories.summary: AI drug discovery startup Boltz has raised $110 million in a Series A round led by Bessemer Venture Partners. The London-based company plans to spend the funds on compute, data and new hires. The raise occurred less than one year after the startup emerged from stealth mode.

stories.title: Everful raises $48.5 million Series A
stories.summary: Everful has raised $48.5 million in a Series A round led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia and India and January Capital. The company claims it is on track to reach $100 million in annualized revenue by year-end, less than two and a half years after its launch.

stories.title: Science Raises $400M in Series D Funding - FinSMEs
Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion Series C
stories.summary: Isomorphic Labs has raised $5 billion in a Series C round to advance its AI-powered drug development pipeline. The round was co-led by Greenoaks, Sequoia Capital and Andreessen Horowitz. Alphabet, which spun the company out of Google DeepMind, also participated in the latest financing round.

stories.title: French robot maker Genesis raises $500 million at $3.5 billion valuation - Reuters
Payhawk raises $280 million at $2 billion valuation
stories.summary: Fintech platform Payhawk has raised $280 million in a Series C round led by Goldman Sachs, valuing the company at $2 billion. The firm provides an enterprise financial management platform that uses AI agents to help companies track expenses. Total funding to date exceeds $500 million.

stories.title: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
stories.summary: Pedestal AI has emerged from stealth with $4.7 million in seed funding to make supply chains faster and more reliable through agentic AI. The company says its plan has already attracted interest from Fortune 500 companies and major shipping firms. The seed round was led by Eclipse.

stories.title: Felicis leads $7.5M bet on Unsiloed AI
stories.summary: Unsiloed AI has raised $7.5 million in seed funding led by Felicis to help enterprises make complex documents accessible to AI agents. The startup aims to interpret tables and charts that systems often struggle to process. The round included participation from Y Combinator and several angel investors.

stories.title: Codex raises $30 million Series A at $130 million valuation
stories.summary: Stablecoin foreign exchange startup Codex has closed a $30 million Series A led by Pantera Capital. The Asia-focused firm reports annualized volume of approximately $25 billion after a tenfold increase this year. The company was founded in 2024 and now holds a post-money valuation of $130 million.

stories.title: Soombit AI raises $9.1 million for medical imaging
stories.summary: Soombit AI has raised $9.1 million in a Series A round led by SV Investment. The startup, founded in 2024 by former Kakao Brain employees, builds generative AI for reading medical images. It was also selected for the government-backed Scale-up TIPS program for its development efforts.

stories.title: Henfruit raises $15 million after a decade of bootstrapping
stories.summary: Branded egg company Henfruit has raised $15 million in its first external funding round led by Lok Capital, DSG Consumer Partners, and RPSG Capital Ventures. The startup, which launched in 2014, plans to use the capital to expand production and distribution across India's largely unorganised egg market.

Pegasus Tech Ventures and Taisei plan $150 million construction fund
stories.summary: Pegasus Tech Ventures and Taisei Corporation plan to launch a $150 million corporate venture capital fund to invest in construction technology. The fund will target AI, robotics, and digital twins over a 10-year period. Pegasus will serve as the general partner for the new investment vehicle.

stories.title: Redalpine closes $250 million fund
stories.summary: Swiss venture capital firm Redalpine has closed its eighth fund at $250 million. The firm intends to explore a deeptech corridor between Europe and the UAE, citing the region's focus on AI and energy transition. The close occurs during a challenging period for European venture capital fundraising.

stories.title: Saviu Ventures closes second fund at $44 million
stories.summary: Saviu Ventures has closed its second fund at approximately $44 million to invest in early-stage startups across Francophone Africa. The fund is four times the size of its predecessor and attracted commitments from the African Development Bank and Bpifrance. It plans to back around 20 companies.

stories.title: First Circle Capital Closes USD 26 M Fund To Back African Fintechs - WeeTracker
Mosaico and Revolv Space secure new funding
stories.summary: Mosaico has raised 7.5 million euros in seed funding led by United Ventures, while Revolv Space secured a 5 million euro Series A round. Mosaico, which focuses on technology development, has raised 8.5 million euros total since its founding in 2023.

stories.title: Serena Williams launches Starfire Ventures
stories.summary: Serena Williams is partnering with venture capitalist Beth Ferreira to launch Starfire Ventures, a firm aiming to raise $200 million. The fund plans to back early-stage startups in healthcare and AI. The firm is designed to operate independently of Williams to ensure longevity beyond her personal involvement.

stories.title: TA Ventures expands focus to DefenceTech
stories.summary: Venture capital firm TA Ventures is expanding its investment focus to include DefenceTech and dual-use technologies. Founder Viktoriya Tigipko notes that while Ukraine is becoming a hub for testing defense solutions, a primary challenge remains turning these technological breakthroughs into scalable global businesses.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields raises 2,295 crore from anchor investors
stories.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields, a Coal India subsidiary, raised 2,295 crore from 53 anchor investors ahead of its IPO. The company allotted over 168 million shares at 136 apiece. Participants include the Life Insurance Corporation of India and the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority. The subscription period begins on Thursday.

stories.title: Ribbit Capital sells 19,050 crore worth of Groww shares
stories.summary: US venture firm Ribbit Capital sold shares worth 19,050 crore in brokerage Groww through block deals on Tuesday. The shares were acquired by funds including BlackRock, Fidelity, and Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund. Ribbit previously sold 113.1 million shares in August. The early investor is reducing its stake.

stories.title: Rediff files updated IPO papers with 600 crore target
stories.summary: Rediff.com has filed updated draft papers for an IPO of up to 600 crore. The company, 82.52 percent owned by AvenuesAI, noted it carried a negative net worth in 2024. The issue consists entirely of new shares, with no offer for sale from existing shareholders.

stories.title: Tech3 | Anthropic set for historic IPO debut, Sarvam defends Token Factory amid backlash, and more - Moneycontrol.com
Anthropic IPO creates 81 billion valuation
stories.summary: Anthropic priced its IPO at 83 per share, valuing the company at 81 billion. While the debut creates a significant windfall for employees, they face unusual restrictions before they can sell their stock. The company's Class A common stock begins trading on the Nasdaq this Thursday.

stories.title: InsuranceDekho puts IPO on hold after employee exits
stories.summary: InsuranceDekho has seen 400 to 500 employees leave following its merger with RenewBuy in September. The Gurgaon-based startup has paused its planned IPO as it rethinks its business model. The move follows anticipated regulatory changes from the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India.

stories.title: Disney targets 3 billion in cost cuts by 2029
stories.summary: Walt Disney is targeting 3 billion in annual cost savings by 2029 and expects further layoffs. CFO Hugh Johnston confirmed more cuts are coming to help the company move faster. Disney has not disclosed how many employees will be affected by the restructuring.

stories.title: Palo Alto Networks to acquire Applied Compute for 4.5 billion
stories.summary: Palo Alto Networks will acquire AI startup Applied Compute in an all-stock deal valued at 4.5 billion. The platform focuses on post-training and inference for open-weight AI models. The transaction is expected to close in the company's fiscal third quarter of 2027, pending regulatory approval.

stories.title: Institutional investors increase stake in Groww
stories.summary: Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund and BlackRock acquired a 1.38 percent stake in Groww parent Billionbrains Garage Ventures for 1,905 crore. The shares were purchased at an average price of 219 apiece. Kotak MF led the buying, acquiring 20.5 million shares in the block deal.

stories.title: AI startup Avoca reaches 1 billion valuation
stories.summary: MIT graduate Apurva Shrivastava founded Avoca, an AI startup that uses voice agents to manage customer calls for home-service companies. The startup has raised over 125 million and reached a 1 billion valuation. The business was inspired by the revenue lost from a single missed phone call.

stories.title: IIT graduate builds AI startup after clearing family debt
stories.summary: Yash Garg, an IIT Delhi graduate, reported clearing 1 crore in family debt using his Google salary and a mobile app business. He is now building an AI startup that has secured a 5.7 million valuation. He shared his journey on LinkedIn to highlight his financial start.

stories.title: MS Dhoni backs 13 startups across various sectors
stories.summary: Former Indian cricket captain MS Dhoni has invested in 13 startups through his family office, Midas Deals. His portfolio spans fintech, electric mobility, gaming, and clean energy. Dhoni is set to transition into a team mentor role for the Chennai Super Kings starting in 2027.

stories.title: Zomato founder tests man's wearable experiment
stories.summary: A venture capital employee attempted to replicate the technology behind Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal's 85,000 Temple wearable using a laptop. The experiment aimed to capture speech without a microphone. Goyal acknowledged the effort and invited the man to test the actual device for a day.

stories.title: Global AI startups increase hiring in India
stories.summary: A cohort of 24 overseas AI and tech companies now employs 24,000 people in India. Global startups are increasingly setting up local teams to tap into the country's engineering talent. The trend marks a shift beyond Big Tech's traditional dominance in the region's hiring market.

stories.title: Autonomous robots race at Bengaluru Tech Summit
stories.summary: Homegrown companies showcased autonomous quadruped robots at the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026. The demonstration featured four-legged machines navigating a track to highlight India's growing capabilities in robotics and Physical AI. The race took place ahead of the event's inaugural session.

stories.title: Udupi entrepreneur opens drone experience centre
stories.summary: Devash K. Hegade has opened Fly Camp, which he describes as India's first drone experience centre. The facility allows people without prior experience to fly drones and learn about the technology. Hegade's interest in the field began during his engineering studies.

stories.title: IronTrex launches app to combat digital scams
stories.summary: Action safety startup IronTrex has launched an app to help shield users from digital fraud. Data from the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre shows Indians lost 22,495 crore to cybercrime in 2025. The Global Anti-Scam Alliance estimated global losses exceeded 442 billion across 42 countries that year.

stories.title: Domain expertise remains key as AI simplifies coding
stories.summary: Industry leaders at TechSparks 2026 discussed the role of domain expertise in software development. While AI makes it easier for non-coders to build prototypes, experts noted that turning those ideas into reliable products still requires human judgement and a clear understanding of the problems being solved.

stories.title: Gen Z startup activity rises as AI fuels business ambitions
stories.summary: LinkedIn reports a 275 percent increase in Gen Z founders, citing artificial intelligence as a primary driver for new ventures. Simultaneously, a Bank of America survey finds existing small business owners are less confident than last year due to inflation and shrinking margins. Ambition is currently outpacing profit.
